title: tc-reliance-gauge
description:
Whether trust in an AI matches its performance: a reliance–accuracy dial with its trend, signals against review
thresholds, overtrust and undertrust episodes, and the recommended review level.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

scope.description: What the numbers cover, a quiet line under the heading – e.g. "Last 30 days · 412 answers"

index.description: The reliance–accuracy index, 0–1 (1: trust matches accuracy). Unset, it is 1 − |reliance − accuracy|

reliance.description: How often people relied on the AI's output, 0–1 – compared with `accuracy` to say which way trust leans

accuracy.description: How often the AI's output was right, 0–1

trend.description: The index over recent windows, oldest first – drawn as the trend line

calibratedAt.description: Index from which the dial reads "Calibrated" (0–1)

driftAt.description: Index from which the dial reads "Drifting"; below it, "Miscalibrated" (0–1)

signals.description: Behaviour signals, each a 0–1 value where higher means more reason to review

spotCheckAt.description: Signal value from which a spot-check is recommended (0–1)

mandatoryAt.description: Signal value from which review of every output is recommended (0–1)

overtrust.description: Overtrust episodes: output relied on, then found wrong

undertrust.description: Undertrust episodes: output overridden, then found right

browsable.description: The episode counts are buttons that fire tc-episodes-open

reviewLevel.description: The review level in force – when it differs from the recommendation, the footer offers to switch

recommended.description: Overrides the recommended level worked out from the signals and the index

reason.description: Overrides the sentence that explains the recommendation

domains.description: The calibration table: one row per domain, the AI's accuracy against the confidence it stated; empty hides it

calibrationTolerance.description: How far confidence may sit from accuracy (0–1) and still read "Well calibrated"

calibrationLabels.description: The names of the calibration bands – in place of Well calibrated, Over-confident and Under-confident

agents.description: Agents to rank by the rating the app gives each; empty hides the ranking

RelianceWindow.description: One recent window of the index – a week, a batch, a release

value.description: 0–1 – higher means more reason to review

hint.description: What the value measures, a quiet line under the label

spotCheckAt.description: This signal's own spot-check threshold (0–1) – defaults to the element's

mandatoryAt.description: This signal's own mandatory threshold (0–1) – defaults to the element's

accuracy.description: How often the AI was right in this domain, 0–1

confidence.description: The confidence it stated there, on average, 0–1

count.description: How many outputs the row rests on – a quiet line under the label

band.description: The band, set outright – otherwise worked out from accuracy, confidence and `calibrationTolerance`

RelianceDomain.description: One row of the calibration table

RelianceCalibration.description: How the AI's stated confidence compares with its accuracy in a domain

rating.description: The rating the app gives it, 0–1 – the ranking sorts by it, highest first

detail.description: A quiet line under the name, e.g. "212 answers"
